text: MIXED: After myelin challenge, APOE3 microglia acidified their lysosomes significantly, whereas APOE4 microglia did not acidify further and showed a slight, non-significant pH increase. The genotype difference in pH depends on condition.
description: Primary microglia from APOE3 and APOE4 targeted-replacement neonatal mice, challenged with 10 µg/ml myelin fragments for 3 h; LysoSensor Green DND-189 flow cytometry. Caveat: mouse microglia, lysosomal not endosomal pH; challenge condition; no direct E4+M vs E3+M statistic reported in text.

provenance.excerpt: E4 microglia did not exhibit further acidification following myelin challenge but rather a slight (albeit not significant) increase of their lysosomal pH (Figure S3).

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) + myelin challenge -> (no further lysosomal acidification in microglia; E3 acidifies) [MIXED]
meccogFinding.dataLocation: Supplementary Fig S3; Results text, p. 14

perturbed.variable: APOE4 vs APOE3 genotype, with myelin challenge (3 h pHrodo myelin, measured 24 h later)

measured.variable: lysosomal pH change after myelin challenge (LysoSensor)
